label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.80 a.2…: In the account of the soul's passive appetitive…
locator: I q.80 a.2 co.; ad 1; ad 2
interpretation: The passage concerns appetitive powers of the soul and their proportion to apprehended objects. Its description as passive must not be transferred without qualification to divine willing in I q.19 a.1. Intellectual appetite is not restricted to universal things as external objects, nor is sense appetite silently identified with will.
